why: Universe 0. A is proposition_17_5_7 together with modelGrPush_tangentValue_eq. The parts of proposition_17_5_7 are (1) TΘ(α) ∈ Gr(α), (2) TΘ(α) = Tφ(TΓ(TΓ^*Θ(x))) for every covering family, every x and every φ : Γ(x) → α, (3) naturality TΘ(tχ) = ν(χ)(TΘ(sχ)), and (4) uniqueness. All four are stated for every α ∈ C¹, that is with regularity ≥ 1 and F(α) ≠ ∅. B asks for a functor F : C_∞ → Gr(C) with π ∘ F = 1 whose value at α equals tangentSectionVia c α for every covering family c. A_to_B builds F from (1) and (3), as the project's tangentSectionFunctorC does. The values come from (2), applied at the point and morphism chosen inside tangentSectionVia. B_to_A does not follow, and the two statements differ in A's favour. A covers objects of C¹ outside C_∞, about which B says nothing. A also gives (17.86) for every representative (x, φ) (modelGrPush_tangentValue_eq), while B only pins down the value at the representative chosen in tangentSectionVia. These are statements the project proves beyond the text's C_∞ section functor; they are not missing proof effort.
